w10_T4_000404: In the morning the fruit market received 133 crates with 8 melons in each, and 552 melons were sold whole. In the afternoon the remaining melons were split equally among 4 stalls, and the first stall cut each of its melons into 6 slices, selling 268 slices. In the evening the first stall sold every remaining slice for 9 rupees. How many rupees did the first stall take in the evening?
w10_T4_000408: The lost-and-found box held 73 items, and 17 more were handed in. Then 41 items were claimed, and the rest were moved to the storage shelf. The office closes at 5. Later 66 items were added to the storage shelf and 14 were donated from it. How many items are on the storage shelf?
w10_T4_000409: Nora bought 24 seed packets and was given 4 more. Each packet contains 3 sachets, and each sachet holds 6 seeds, all of which she tipped into her seed tin. The garden is 9 metres wide. She added 14 loose seeds to the tin and took 18 out for a window box. Her friend Eli has fewer seeds than Nora. How many seeds are in Nora's tin?
w10_T4_000418: Nadia's bakery bakes 217 trays of 8 loaves every day and did so for 6 days. It also baked 22 extra loaves for a wedding. Every loaf sold for 3 dollars, and the running costs for the period were 28218 dollars, leaving the profit. Her competitor Sam made less profit than Nadia. How many dollars of profit did Nadia make?
w10_T4_000419: Ola's cafe had 176 pints of milk, then received 25 pints and another 11. She used 49 pints for baking and 8 pints spoiled. She serves the rest as cups, at 2 cups to a pint. Her rival Ken served fewer cups than Ola. How many cups of milk can Ola serve?
w10_T4_000432: A chocolate factory loads 133 boxes on each pallet, 5 pallets on each truck, and sends 4 trucks, plus 55 loose boxes. The trucks drove 120 kilometres. Each box holds 3 packs, each pack holds 2 bars, and each bar weighs 9 grams. How many grams of chocolate were sent?
w10_T4_000442: The brewery tapped 170 gallons of ale, measured in quarts at 4 quarts to a gallon, and served it in cups at 4 cups to a quart. It served 1183 cups on Friday and 664 cups on Saturday. Then 66 cups came back untouched and 75 cups were drawn from a spare keg. How many cups of ale does the brewery have?
w10_T4_000443: In the morning the depot held 84 parcels, and the drivers delivered 41 of them. In the afternoon they delivered 30 more, and then 71 new parcels arrived. In the evening each parcel was labelled with 3 stickers. How many stickers were used?
w10_T4_000444: The campsite had 167 tents and put up 60 more for the festival. The site covers 12 hectares. Each tent needs 7 pegs, which the crew stored in the peg bin. Then 343 bent pegs were thrown out of the bin, and 7 spare pegs were added. How many pegs are in the peg bin?
w10_T4_000445: Jin's shop received 173 packs with 5 pens in each and put every pen in the display. He sold 188 pens on Monday and 306 on Tuesday. On Wednesday he found 5 pens under the counter and added them. Mei's shop has fewer pens than Jin's. How many pens are in Jin's display?
w10_T4_000448: A cider maker pressed 240 gallons, then 40 more, and stirs it twice a day. He divided the cider equally among 5 barrels. He topped up the first barrel with 37 more gallons. He bottles by the pint, and there are 8 pints in a gallon. How many pints will the first barrel fill?
w10_T4_000452: In the morning Petra's stall had 213 tulips; she sold 48, received 13, and moved everything into the display bucket. In the afternoon she sold 107 tulips from the bucket and added 54. In the evening she sold 55 and removed 26 wilted stems. Her neighbour Otto sold fewer tulips than Petra. How many tulips are in the display bucket?
w10_T4_000454: Liam had 106 yards of twine, and 6 yards frayed. He bought 62 yards more and measured it all twice. He works in feet, at 3 feet to a yard, and used 185 feet on a trellis. Ava gave him 79 feet and still has more feet of twine than Liam. How many feet of twine does Liam have?
w10_T4_000456: Ava had 14 cupcakes and gave a dozen to her class. The class has 26 pupils. She cut each remaining cupcake into 5 pieces, ate 5 pieces, and gave 4 pieces to Ben, who then had more pieces than Ava. Then a tray with 39 pieces was handed to her. How many pieces does Ava have?
w10_T4_000457: The textile mill has 239 looms, and each loom makes 6 rolls a day. It ran for 9 days and also bought 26 rolls. The mill employs 80 people. Every roll is cut into 6 pieces, and each piece is booked at 9 credits in the ledger. How many credits are in the ledger?
w10_T4_000462: Priya's project has 74 weeks, and 57 weeks are done. She writes the rest in days, at 7 days to a week, then takes 16 days off for holidays and adds 23 days for a client extension. The team has 9 members. She splits the days equally into 6 sprints. How many days does each sprint have?
w10_T4_000463: The fishing crew had 179 fathoms of line and bought 51 more, then 71, then 8, checking the reel twice. The skipper records line in feet, and a fathom is 6 feet. How many feet of line does the crew have?
w10_T4_000464: In the morning the brewery filled 82 kegs with 6 gallons each and logged the total in quarts, at 4 quarts to a gallon. In the afternoon it sold 1197 quarts and took back 64 quarts from a cancelled order. In the evening every remaining quart was priced at 9 dollars. How many dollars is the remaining ale worth?
w10_T4_000468: Kai had 135 stickers and won 21 more. A trading event doubled his stickers. He found 22 stickers in a drawer and then gave 50 to Lena, who has fewer stickers than Kai. How many stickers does Kai have?
w10_T4_000469: Theo had 51 nickels, spent 27, and earned 80 more. His piggy bank is 8 inches tall. He counted his nickels in cents, at 5 cents to a nickel, and then earned the same amount again the next day, doubling his cents. He spent 225 cents on a comic and found 3 cents. How many cents does Theo have?
w10_T4_000477: In the morning Max had 63 marbles and lost 46, then a friend matched his marbles, doubling them. In the afternoon he found 24 marbles. In the evening he traded every marble for 3 tokens, and Ivy, who has more tokens than Max, gave him 44 tokens. How many tokens does Max have?
w10_T4_000478: Sana's shop received 169 bolts of cloth, each 9 metres long, in 5 identical shipments. The shop opened 20 years ago. She sold 4092 metres and cut every remaining metre into 2 strips. Each strip is booked at 7 rupees in her sales ledger. Her rival Deepa's ledger shows fewer rupees than Sana's. How many rupees are in Sana's ledger?
w10_T4_000479: The car park held 191 cars at noon. The car park, which has a dozen floors, charges 3 dollars an hour. Then 159 cars left, 75 arrived, 4 more arrived, and 22 left. How many cars are in the car park?
w10_T4_000480: Jo has 29 gallons of paint, measured in pints at 8 pints to a gallon. She uses 162 pints on the fence and 41 pints on the shed. Kim gives her 27 pints and then has fewer pints of paint than Jo. How many pints of paint does Jo have?
w10_T4_000483: Ravi found 91 nickels and spent 48 of them. He counted the rest in cents, at 5 cents to a nickel, and saved that same amount each day for 8 days. He repeated the whole 8-day plan 7 times, then added 39 cents. His sister Meena saved fewer cents than Ravi. How many cents did Ravi save?
